response.original_title: What Is the Cash App Weekly ☎️+1(888)-805-1229 Sending Limit?
response.overview: The weekly sending limit is the most clearly defined restriction: •	Unverified accounts: $250 per 7-day rolling period ☎️+1(888)-805-1229  •	Verified accounts: Up to $7,500 per week ☎️+1(888)-805-1229  The 7-day period is rolling, not calendar-based. That means the system calculates the total amount sent over the previous seven days at any given moment. If ☎️+1(888)-805-1229 we send $2,000 on Monday, that amount counts toward the limit until the following Monday. . While there is no officially published monthly sending cap for verified accounts, the ☎️+1(888)-805-1229 weekly cap of $7,500 indirectly shapes how much can be sent over a month. For unverified accounts, the monthly ☎️+1(888)-805-1229 receiving cap is $1,000 per 30 days, and sending remains limited to $250 per week.
